NewsArticle.Title: Dark Ages vote on CNET
NewsArticle.Content:
To support online roleplaying and adventure, please take a moment to vote for Dark Ages. With your added support, even more new features are possible.
[CNet Downloads](http://download.cnet.com/downloads/0-10035-100-1808271.html?tag=st.dl.10035_106_1.lst.td): Click 'Yes' then 'Submit.'
